name: Magical Trouble
source:
Young Tina made a magical blunder taking herself and Takumi to a different world. Not only that, but it seems a spirit has possessed Takumi's body... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE063414.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
年轻的蒂娜在施展魔法时出了差错，将自己与拓海带到了另一个世界。不仅如此，似乎还有一个灵体附身在拓海身上…

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE063414.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
